findings.title: Preflight and payload contracts conflict
findings.fix: Define one exact result shape with warnings, payload nullability, issue codes/paths, and deterministic revision semantics.

findings.title: Delivery/read/typing states lack projection and UI contract
findings.fix: Define a versioned event/status union, server emission and provider mapping, rendering component, and stale/unknown-state behavior.

findings.title: Persistence can violate shared-link guarantees and lacks hash lifecycle
findings.fix: Specify source/hash ownership, shared-link guards, async hash readiness, queued writes, and invariant tests.

findings.title: Aspect-ratio authoring and rendering path is incomplete
findings.fix: Define schema, normalized types, carousel/card precedence, invalid-ratio gate, and end-to-end fixtures.

findings.title: Error envelope and reset recovery are underspecified
findings.fix: Define exact client/server error mapping, malformed-response fallback, polling expiry, and reset/loading transitions.

findings.title: Selector keyboard and compare behavior is ambiguous
findings.fix: Specify independent group keyboard/state tables, compare behavior, descriptions, and focus restoration.

findings.title: Official logo requirement is not met by official-looking paths
findings.fix: Identify approved local assets and provenance, and define BrandIcon semantic API and tests.

findings.title: Responsive and 200% zoom behavior lacks concrete layout contract
findings.fix: Name the owning layout, define panel/control reflow and overflow constraints, and list manual verification outcomes.

findings.title: Validation boundary and compatibility claims conflict
findings.fix: Add a matrix assigning structural, channel, live-warning, and payload issues to exact gates and channels.

findings.title: Phone copy does not document accepted plus/separator grammar
findings.fix: Align copy and client validation with normalized server recipient grammar.
